mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_cluster_shadow_generation WHERE generation_key=#{generationKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_cluster_shadow_generation WHERE generation_status='BUILDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cluster_shadow_generation SET processed_count=#{processedCount},actionable_count=#{actionableCount}, terminal_count=#{terminalCount},cluster_count=#{clusterCount},provisional_count=#{provisionalCount}, input_digest=#{inputDigest},assignment_digest=#{assignmentDigest}, reverse_assignment_digest=#{reverseAssignmentDigest} WHERE id=#{id} AND generation_status='BUILDING' AND processed_count=0

UPDATE t_cluster_shadow_generation SET generation_status='VERIFIED',verification_digest=#{verificationDigest}, verified_by=#{actorId}, verified_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),failure_code=NULL,failure_summary=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND generation_status='BUILDING' AND processed_count=expected_source_count AND assignment_digest=reverse_assignment_digest
